title: Claude Just Dropped ULTRA CODE. (Everything You Need to Know in 5 min).
description:
Join my AI newsletter to stay up to date on everything AI: https://tristen-obrien.kit.com/59e783d0c3
________________

Claude just got a new setting called Ultra Code, and it turns one Claude into a team of up to 100 workers that split a job, run it all at the same time, and check each other's work before handing it back to you. In this video I break down what it actually is, the two pieces that make it work (xhigh thinking + dynamic workflows), how to flip it on, Ultra Code vs Max, a live demo where I research an entire food truck business, and the cost that may surprise you.

If this helps you get up to speed, do me a favor and hit subscribe. It's the best way to support the channel.
